title: Fountain
description: Hydrate: an outdoor drinking fountain and bottle filler for parks and trails. Speed-modeling ideation in Blender put dozens of quick forms side by side before one direction was taken to a final visualization in a park setting.

metrics.label: Share held by bottle filling stations, 2025
Bottle filler growth per year, the fastest segment

research_intro: Bottle fillers are the fastest-growing part of the drinking fountain market, driven by reusable-bottle use in parks, campuses and offices.

brief.label: Brief
brief.text: A public drinking fountain and bottle filler for outdoor paths.

brief.label: Process
brief.text: Speed-modeling ideation in Blender, then refinement of one form.

brief.label: Competition
brief.text: Elkay (Zurn Elkay), Haws, Oasis and Murdock lead public drinking fountains and bottle fillers.
